newsitem.title: USA: Indiana to provide support for AK steel plant.
newsitem.headline: Indiana to provide support for AK steel plant.

text.p: Indiana Gov. Evan Bayh announced Thursday the state will provide $12.7 million in financial support to a new plant AK Steel Holding Corp. plans to build near the town of Rockport.
The company unveiled plans on Thursday for a $1.1 billion carbon and stainless flat-rolled steel processing complex that will create 410 new jobs.

According to a news release from Bayh, the state will provide the company with a $400,000 grant for workforce training, $5 million in infrastructure funds from the Indiana Department of Commerce, and up to $5.8 million in tax credits.
In addition, the state's transportation department will undertake $1.5 million in road improvements near the 1,700-acre plant site, the release said.
A maximum of $59 million in local tax abatements was also included in the incentive package, according to a fact sheet on the project from the Indiana Department of Commerce.
